description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5925012981013 CIRCUIT BREAKER: Line 0001 Qty 202 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0078 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
